truth_boundary: This artifact starts evidence acquisition only. It does not create labels, independent reviewer attestations, blind-holdout labels, empirical attestation, Track B approval, publication or Production authorization.

lanes.rule: collect only real source records with payload digest, license evidence and provenance; no algorithmic label generation
use only authority identifiers actually present in source payloads; no inferred serial identity
historical provenance/event semantics only; current market claims prohibited
use only MusicBrainz core database dump fields distributed under CC0; exclude supplementary/derived data, cover art and live replication feed unless separately rights-cleared
source acquisition only from real Wikidata items carrying manufacturer + model number + GTIN; labels must be assigned later by independent reviewers, never algorithmically from these identifiers

lanes.blocker: RIGHTS_ADMITTED_COLLECTIBLE_VEHICLE_SOURCE_FAMILY_AT_120_CASE_SCALE_REQUIRED; NHTSA vPIC bulk VIN API use prohibited
PCGS_CURRENT_AUTHORIZATION_IS_MINIMAL_BOUNDED_EVALUATION_NOT_120_CASE_EMPIRICAL_HARVEST; separate rights-compatible source or permission required
